change: The cache block is one map of named entries, each taking path (was dir), refresh (run, day, week, month or never), version, inputs (were unit and shared file entries), tools (were tool: entries) and unit (one pattern with {unit}; pubkit cache run takes --unit VALUE); an entry needs refresh or inputs, an unknown key fails pubkit sync naming it, each entry gets its own cache key, and actions/cache's save prunes, so pubkit cache prune is no longer a workflow step
